support_definition: Joint support_i = calibrated in-scope score times calibrated conditional class score_i. Scores sum to the in-scope score, not necessarily one.
decision_rule: Exactly one support score strictly above the selected common threshold -> automatic label; zero or multiple -> human review. No forced top-1 fallback.

confidence_only_matched_coverage.selection: Closest known-shot coverage to the main policy on policy groups only; ties prefer higher automatic known accuracy, then lower threshold.
